scan.summary: This is your own monitoring log for Air Contaminant Discharge Permit 26-2841-ST-01. It records the daily pressure drop across scrubbers S-1 and S-2 (Condition 3.1) and the weekly breakthrough check at the outlet of carbon unit C-1 (Condition 3.3). It is the evidence that you are meeting those conditions, and it currently has holes: August is missing a week of readings, September is missing one weekly C-1 check, a reading on September 9 was above the permit limit with nothing recorded about it, and no supervisor has signed it.
scan.freshness_note: The last entry is September 25, 2026, five days before today. There are no rows for September 28–30. If the lines ran on those days, the readings need to go in now. The week-of-September-28 C-1 check is due this week.

gaps.title: August 17–21 daily pressure-drop readings missing
gaps.description: By the log's own line counters, the acid line ran 21 days and the caustic line 20 days in August, but only 16 rows were entered. The missing rows are the whole week of August 17–21. A C-1 check was logged on August 17, which suggests the plant was running that week. That makes about 5 operating days with no S-1 reading and 5 with no S-2 reading.
gaps.fix: Find out whether readings were taken that week and just not written down (check shift notes or any other records). If they were not taken, treat it as missed monitoring under Condition 3.1. Check what the permit says about reporting monitoring deviations, record the reason, and set up a daily check so a day cannot be skipped.
gaps.citation: Air Contaminant Discharge Permit 26-2841-ST-01, Condition 3.1 (as quoted in the log header)
gaps.locator: Page 1, August table and throughput line
gaps.quote: August throughput (from the line counters): acid line ran 21 days, caustic line ran 20 days. Rows entered: 16.

gaps.title: S-2 reading above the permit range on September 9 with no note or corrective action
gaps.description: On September 9 the S-2 (caustic line) pressure drop was 6.4 inches of water column. That is above the 6.0 upper limit in Condition 3.1, and the caustic line was running. The Notes column is blank: nothing says what caused it, what was done, or when the reading came back into range. The next day it read 4.6.
gaps.fix: Write up what happened on September 9: the cause, the corrective action, and the time it returned to range. Check the permit's deviation and excess-emission reporting conditions. DEQ's excess emissions rules (which I believe are OAR 340-214-0300 through -0360, but please check) may require you to notify DEQ or include this in your periodic report. Keep that write-up with this log.
gaps.citation: Permit 26-2841-ST-01, Condition 3.1. Possibly OAR 340 Division 214 excess emissions rules; section numbers not verified.

gaps.title: Weekly C-1 check missing for the week of September 14
gaps.description: Condition 3.3 requires a weekly breakthrough check at the C-1 outlet. The September table has only the weeks of September 7 and 21. The week of September 14 is missing, and the pressure-drop rows show the plant ran September 14–18.
gaps.fix: Find out whether the check was done and not written down. If it was missed, record it as a missed weekly check and handle it the way the permit requires for monitoring deviations. Put the week of September 28 check on the schedule now.
gaps.citation: Air Contaminant Discharge Permit 26-2841-ST-01, Condition 3.3 (as quoted in the log)

gaps.title: Supervisor review not signed
gaps.description: The supervisor review signature and date lines at the bottom of the log are blank. Nobody has signed off on either month, which is also why the September 9 reading and the missing entries went unflagged.
gaps.fix: Have the supervisor review both months, sign and date the log, and write down how each gap above was handled.

gaps.title: No line-counter operating-day totals for September
gaps.description: August gives operating-day totals from the line counters, so you can check that every operating day was logged. September gives no totals, so it cannot be checked the same way.
gaps.fix: Add September's line-counter totals and compare them with the 18 rows entered.

deadlines.title: Record S-1 and S-2 pressure drop on every day each line runs; keep it between 2.0 and 6.0 in. w.c.
deadlines.source_line: Condition 3.1: record the pressure drop across each scrubber once per operating day; keep it between 2.0 and 6.0 inches of water column whenever the line is operating.

deadlines.title: Weekly C-1 carbon unit outlet breakthrough check (week of September 28 is due now)
deadlines.source_line: Condition 3.3: weekly check for breakthrough at the C-1 carbon unit outlet
